# GEO report: brightside-dental **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 73/100, Good Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 18.25 ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. High = (18.25 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. I read every source file in this small Eleventy site. Nothing was left unknown, but four problems cost points. Most of the loss comes from the canonical tag (the tag that tells search engines the official address of a page) pointing at a staging domain, plus a broken structured-data block and a missing `lang`. All results are read from code, not measured on a live site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Point the canonical at the real domain - **Why it matters:** every page tells search engines its official address is on `staging.`, not your real `www.` site, which can send them to the wrong place. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small (use `https://www.brightside-dental.example{{ page.url }}`, which is the origin in `geo.config.json`) - **Score after this:** 81/100 ### 2. Fix the invalid JSON-LD on the contact page - **Why it matters:** JSON-LD is structured data that labels your business details for machines. The trailing comma makes it invalid JSON, so it is likely to be ignored entirely. - **Where:** `src/contact.njk:10` - **What the code says:** `"telephone": "0113 496 0000", }` - **Size:** Small (remove the comma) - **Score after this:** 81/100 ### 3. Add `lang` to the page and a description to the team page - **Why it matters:** without `lang`, tools have to guess the page language. The team page also shares no description, so it has no summary to show. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:2` and `src/team.njk:1-4` - **What the code says:** `` and a front matter with only `title: Meet the team` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 81/100 Doing all three gives 18.25 + 6 = 24.25 ÷ 25 = 97/100. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt valid and reachable | Clear | `src/robots.txt` is plain, valid, and passthrough-copied | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Clear | `src/robots.txt:1-2` allows `*`; policy is "allow" | | GEO-014 | Listed routes are indexable | Problem | `/services/` is noindex but in the sitemap (`src/services.njk:5`); 3 of 4 routes clear | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own domain | Problem | `src/_includes/base.njk:8`, all routes use staging host | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Clear | Eleventy builds static HTML | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Problem | `src/contact.njk:10`, trailing comma | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Clear | `src/sitemap.xml`, `Sitemap:` line at `src/robots.txt:3` | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | No `lang` at `src/_includes/base.njk:2`; no description on `/team/` | | GEO-016 | Routes reachable by links | Clear | Nav `` at `src/_includes/base.njk:12` | | GEO-017 | No snippet conflict | Clear | Only `data-nosnippet` on one element (`src/contact.njk:8`); no headers set in the repo | | GEO-002 | Accessibility checks | Clear | Read `base.njk` and `index.njk`; the only image has alt text | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | Not scored; none present | | GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | Not scored | ## Other problems found - **Sitemap lists a noindex page:** `src/sitemap.xml:4`: `https://www.brightside-dental.example/services/` but `src/services.njk:5` has `noindex: true`. This is probably a mistake, since Services is your main page. Remove the `noindex` line (or take the page out of the sitemap). - **Hosts disagree:** the canonical uses `staging.` (`src/_includes/base.njk:8`) while the sitemap uses `www.` (`src/sitemap.xml:3`). Fixing item 1 resolves it. - **Image file missing:** `src/index.njk:8` has ``, but no `src/img/` exists in the repo and `.eleventy.js:1` doesn't copy one. The image would 404 unless it's added and passthrough-copied. ## Worth considering - **Back up "Trusted by thousands":** `src/index.njk:7`: `Trusted by thousands of local patients.` Add a real number, review count or testimonial, or soften the claim. - **Name the dentists:** `src/team.njk:6`: `decades of experience between them.` List each dentist's name, role and qualifications as text. Individual pages would give each person their own address. - **Show prices or say where to find them:** `src/services.njk:9`: `Our prices are simple and clear.` No prices appear, so add them or link to them. - **Describe each service:** `src/services.njk:8` is only a bare `
    `. A short paragraph per treatment, or a page each, would answer what visitors come to ask. - **Add address and hours to the structured data:** `src/contact.njk:10` has only name and telephone. The address (`12 Park Row, Leeds`) is already on the page, so add `address`, `openingHours` and `url` to the Dentist block. Opening hours aren't stated anywhere yet. - **Add `` to the sitemap:** `src/sitemap.xml:3-6` has no dates. Hand-kept, it could be generated from Eleventy's collections. - **Add site identity and social tags:** `src/_includes/base.njk:3-10` has no `og:` tags, and no WebSite or Organization data names the clinic. - **Make the emergency promise easy to find:** `src/index.njk:7`: `Emergency appointments available.` Link it to the contact details or say when and how to reach someone. - **Add a 404 page:** no `404.njk` exists in `src/`, so wrong addresses have nothing to show. - **Make titles more specific:** `src/_includes/base.njk:6` gives "Contact | Brightside Dental" with no location. Adding "Leeds" might help. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs `, which checks real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live status codes and headers:** whether the deployed pages answer 200 and send no `X-Robots-Tag` header. A live scan with your URL would confirm this. - **Deployed canonical:** the `staging.` host may be swapped in at deploy time, but nothing in this repo does that. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find the site (`policy.aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"`). - `/thanks/` is deliberately noindex and kept out of the sitemap, so I didn't count it as a route. - `https://www.brightside-dental.example` is the real origin, per `geo.config.json`. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
